testsuite.name: org.mozilla.fenix.settings.SettingsFragmentTest

testcase.name: GIVEN notifications are not allowed THEN set the appropriate summary to notification preferences
GIVEN the HttpsOnly is set to all tabs THEN set the appropriate preference summary
GIVEN the tracking protection preference is set to custom THEN set the appropriate summary
Add-on collection override pref is visible if debug menu active and feature is enabled
GIVEN notifications are allowed THEN set the appropriate summary to notification preferences
GIVEN email mask feature is not available for the user WHEN relay eligibility is Ineligible THEN preference is hidden
Install add-on from file pref is visible if debug menu active and feature is enabled
GIVEN email mask feature is not available for the user WHEN relay eligibility is Eligible THEN preference is hidden
WHEN ip protection feature is not available for the user THEN preference is hidden
GIVEN the opening screen setting is set to last tab THEN set the appropriate summary to homepage preference
GIVEN the tracking protection preference is set to standard THEN set the appropriate summary
GIVEN an account observer WHEN the fragment is visible THEN register it for updates
GIVEN the tracking protection preference is disabled THEN set the appropriate summary
WHEN a custom search engine is set as default THEN it's name is set as summary for search preference
Add-on collection override pref is visible if already configured and feature is enabled
GIVEN an account observer WHEN the fragment stops being visible THEN unregister it for updates
WHEN ip protection feature is available for the user THEN preference is visible
GIVEN email mask feature is available for the user WHEN relay eligibility is Ineligible THEN preference is hidden
GIVEN the opening screen setting is set to homepage THEN set the appropriate summary to homepage preference
GIVEN the opening screen setting is set to homepage after four hours THEN set the appropriate summary to homepage preference
GIVEN the HttpsOnly is set to private tabs THEN set the appropriate preference summary
GIVEN the HttpsOnly is disabled THEN set the appropriate preference summary
GIVEN email mask feature is available for the user WHEN relay eligibility is Eligible THEN preference is visible
Add-on collection override pref is not visible if feature is disabled
GIVEN the tracking protection preference is set to strict THEN set the appropriate summary
